full_prompt_en: A square contemporary interior photograph shows a glossy black oval dining table surrounded by pale upholstered chairs in a restrained white, charcoal and gold room. The table occupies the lower center, with its rounded near edge reflecting glassware, dark plates and soft ceiling light. Several place settings circle it in measured spacing, while tall dark vases hold a dense mound of white blossoms at the center. Creamy curved chairs wrap around the table; the nearest two fill the bottom corners and frame the black surface. Above, a cluster of clear glass globe pendants hangs at different heights on thin dark cords. Small brass fittings catch warm highlights, and the globes mirror fragments of the room. Across the rear wall, black reflective panels and a large mirror extend the view into a second space with a pale counter and more flowers. A dark doorway opens just left of center, while a quiet geometric artwork hangs on the white wall at far left. On the right, a black stone-like vertical panel adds a heavy edge to the airy pale background. Daylight washes the white ceiling and chair backs, while warm pendant glints and reflections animate the dark table and panels. Smooth lacquer, translucent glass, soft upholstery, polished metal and clustered petals remain distinctly visible. The overall composition is symmetrical but not rigid, using repeated round forms and a sharp black-white contrast to create an elegant, luminous dining space.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形当代室内照片呈现一张光亮黑色椭圆餐桌，周围是浅色软垫椅，房间配色克制在白、炭黑和金色之间。餐桌占据下方中央，近处圆边映出玻璃杯、深色餐盘与柔和顶光。多套餐具均匀围绕桌面，几只高深色花瓶在中央托起一大团白花。奶油白弧形椅环绕桌子；最近的两把填入下方两角，框住黑色桌面。上方，一组透明玻璃球形吊灯以细深色线悬在不同高度。小黄铜接头接住暖高光，玻璃球映出房间的碎片。后墙上，黑色反光板与大镜面把视线延伸到另一处带浅色台面和更多花的空间。中央稍左打开一道深色门口，最左侧白墙上挂着一幅安静的几何画。右边，一块黑色石质般的竖面为通透浅色背景增添厚重边界。日光洗亮白天花与椅背，暖色吊灯亮点及反射使深色桌面和墙板活跃。平滑漆面、透明玻璃、柔软椅面、抛光金属与簇拥花瓣都清楚可辨。整体构图对称却不僵硬，以重复圆形和锐利黑白对比形成优雅明亮的用餐空间。
style_prompt_en: A refined contemporary photographic treatment uses a tight range of ivory, graphite black, soft gray and small champagne-metal highlights. Broad glossy dark surfaces alternate with pale matte expanses, while transparent spherical reflections provide a lighter repeated rhythm. Edges are clean and architectural, yet rounded silhouettes soften the geometry. Diffuse daylight provides even clarity; localized warm glints from suspended sources and polished surfaces add depth without overpowering the neutral palette. Fine fabric texture and clustered soft detail interrupt otherwise smooth planes. Layered reflections extend the apparent space, and a balanced arrangement of dark center, pale perimeter and floating highlights gives the frame a quiet luxury.
style_prompt_zh: 精致的当代摄影处理把色域收紧在象牙白、石墨黑、柔灰与少量香槟金属高光。宽阔光亮暗面与浅色哑光面交替，透明球状反射提供更轻盈的重复节奏。边缘干净而有结构感，圆润剪影又柔化几何形。漫射日光带来均匀清晰度；悬挂光源与抛光表面的局部暖亮点增加纵深，却不压过中性色盘。细织物肌理和簇状柔细节打断其他地方的光滑色面。层叠反射延伸表观空间，深色中心、浅色周缘与浮动高光的均衡安排赋予画面安静的奢华感。
theme_en: A black oval dining table with white flowers beneath suspended glass globes
theme_zh: 玻璃球形吊灯下，黑色椭圆餐桌摆着白花
name: Kelly Hoppen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
